from fastapi import APIRouter
from .models import Run, Participant, RunCreate, ParticipantJoin
from .store import run_store, participant_store, reset
from .errors import ApiError

import uuid
import datetime as dt

router = APIRouter()


def _run_to_response(run: Run) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": run.id,
        "title": run.title,
        "datetime": run.datetime,
        "location": run.location,
        "distance": run.distance,
        "pace_target": run.pace_target,
        "route_notes": run.route_notes,
        "participant_count": run.participant_count,
        "participants": list(run.participants),
    }


@router.post("/runs", status_code=201)
def create_run(payload: RunCreate):
    if not payload.title or not payload.title.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "title is required")
    if not payload.datetime or not payload.datetime.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "datetime is required")
    if not payload.location or not payload.location.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "location is required")

    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    run = Run(
        id=run_id,
        title=payload.title.strip(),
        datetime=payload.datetime.strip(),
        location=payload.location.strip(),
        distance=payload.distance or "",
        pace_target=payload.pace_target or "",
        route_notes=payload.route_notes or "",
        participant_count=0,
        participants=[],
    )
    run_store[run_id] = run
    return _run_to_response(run)


@router.get("/runs")
def list_runs():
    return [_run_to_response(run) for run in run_store.values()]


@router.get("/runs/{run_id}")
def get_run(run_id: str):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run '{run_id}' not found")
    return _run_to_response(run_store[run_id])


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/participants", status_code=201)
def join_run(run_id: str, payload: ParticipantJoin):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run '{run_id}' not found")

    name = payload.name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "participant name is required")

    run = run_store[run_id]
    name_lower = name.strip().lower()

    for existing in run.participants:
        if existing.lower() == name_lower:
            raise ApiError("duplicate_participant", f"Participant '{name.strip()}' is already on this run")

    participant = Participant(
        name=name.strip(),
        joined_at=dt.datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
    )

    composite_key = f"{run_id}:{name_lower}"
    participant_store[composite_key] = participant

    run.participants.append(name.strip())
    run.participant_count = len(run.participants)

    return {"name": participant.name, "joined_at": participant.joined_at}


@router.delete("/runs/{run_id}/participants/{participant_name}", status_code=204)
def leave_run(run_id: str, participant_name: str):
    if run_id not in run_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run '{run_id}' not found")

    name = participant_name
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "participant name is required")

    run = run_store[run_id]
    name_lower = name.strip().lower()

    found_index = None
    for i, existing in enumerate(run.participants):
        if existing.lower() == name_lower:
            found_index = i
            break

    if found_index is None:
        raise ApiError("participant_not_found", f"Participant '{name.strip()}' not found on this run")

    run.participants.pop(found_index)
    run.participant_count = len(run.participants)

    composite_key = f"{run_id}:{name_lower}"
    if composite_key in participant_store:
        del participant_store[composite_key]

    return None
